newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's GDP grew 3.0 pct yr/yr in 1996-INE.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's GDP grew 3.0 pct yr/yr in 1996-INE.

text.p: The Portuguese economy, as measured by gross domestic product (GDP), rose three percent in 1996, up from two percent the previous year, the National Statistics Institute said on Friday.
The figure was slightly above the 2.8 percent calculated earlier this year by the government but below the 3.3 percent announced by the Bank of Portugal.

INE gave the following figures for the third and fourth quarters of 1996. Due to certain changes in methodology, figures from 1993 through to the second quarter of 1996 were revised, it said. All figures other than GDP are expressed as percentages of GDP.
